three.js r186 (three@0.186.0 on npm, https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js)
MIT License -- full text in three-LICENSE.txt (copied unmodified from the
npm package's own LICENSE file).

three.module.min.js is three's build/three.module.js and build/three.core.js
bundled into one file and minified. Vendored here -- rather than loaded from
a CDN, the usual approach for a no-build-step project -- because
the pages (planetgen/web/__init__.py's SECURITY_HEADERS) send
`Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'` and only ever serves same-
origin `static/*.js`; a CDN script would need a script-src exception to that
policy. sectormap.js imports this file directly by relative path (no
import map, so none of that CSP is touched).

Rebuild from a fresh `three` npm release (bumping the version below) with:

  npm pack three                              # downloads three-<version>.tgz
  tar xzf three-<version>.tgz package/build/three.module.js \
                                 package/build/three.core.js \
                                 package/LICENSE
  npx esbuild --bundle --minify --format=esm \
      package/build/three.module.js --outfile=three.module.min.js

then copy the resulting three.module.min.js and package/LICENSE (as
three-LICENSE.txt) here.


Shoelace 2.20.1 (@shoelace-style/shoelace on npm, https://shoelace.style)
MIT License -- full text in shoelace/LICENSE.md (copied unmodified from the
npm package).

shoelace/ holds only what the shared component set (components.js) uses:
the cdn/ build's component modules and the chunks they import, the light
theme's non-colour tokens (themes/light.css; shoelace-theme.css points its
colours at the site's own), the "gear" Bootstrap icon, and the few icons
Shoelace draws itself (assets/system/), saved as files because its own
copies are data: URIs the Content-Security-Policy would refuse. The files
are loaded with their own ?v= query like the rest of static/ (see
components.js), so no import map and no CSP exception is needed.

Rebuild from a fresh release (bumping the version above) with:

  npm pack @shoelace-style/shoelace@<version>
  tar xzf shoelace-style-shoelace-<version>.tgz
  python scripts/vendor_shoelace.py package

To use another component, add it to COMPONENTS in scripts/vendor_shoelace.py
and to components.js, and run the script again (it needs node for the icons).
